speed_only_method: pitch-preserving time stretch, rate=1.10 relative to selected source
processed_base_method: speed-only plus 0.8-semitone pitch shift, gentle low-pass, 55ms room reflection, and RMS set to 82% of speed-only
voice_design_prompt: A mature woman's voice, soft and composed, with a low-to-mid feminine register. She sounds slightly distant, as if speaking thoughtfully from across a quiet room, while every word remains intelligible. Gentle warmth, restrained synthetic resonance, and a little dry wit. She observes and wonders before speaking, choosing each word with purpose. Keep the delivery calm, curious, and unhurried, with natural pauses. Give 'Viv' a quiet warm rise, 'one piece' deliberate emphasis, and 'next' a subtle forward lift. Avoid whispering, breathiness, theatrical emotion, and heavy reverb.
note: processed base preserves the selected recording's words; new VoiceDesign generation may change identity
